messages:
sarah: FYI — NimbusCo had another peering isolation event this morning. Seems similar to last week: on-prem firewall reset + backend fallback causing cross-tenant noise. Need a tight set of postmortem follow-ups and clear owners.
ben: saw that. logs attached in ticket. looks like KV cache eviction + fallback to default route. suggests adding stricter isolation checks in runtime.
kevin: can we get a timeline of the repeated flaps? we should track recurrence rate and MTTR as KPIs. I'll own the KPI dashboard if someone can own remediation.
olivia: flagged — NimbusCo is air-gapped; we can't push an agent. customer config change windows are limited to evenings.
maria: agree on KPIs. propose: 1) MTTR, 2) recurrence per-week, 3) isolation-breach count. add to postmortem tracker and set severity for each action.
jason: I can take Runbook update + alerting (automation) — aiming EOD in two weeks. will add playbook steps + runbook snippet.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: peering-flap detected (tenant NimbusCo). ticket #INC-4721 created.
ben: for runtime patch: suggest feature-flag 'strict-tenant-check' that prevents fallback route on mismatch. low-risk toggle. I'll prototype and open PR.
kevin: PR/patches fine but need customer coordination. I'll own customer scheduling and confirm firewall rollback window. target: schedule config change 2025-02-10 02:00 UTC.
olivia: I'll sync with NimbusCo PM tomorrow and secure the window. will paste their ticket id once confirmed.
maria: Action items summary (add to tracker):
- Ben: prototype feature-flag + PR (due 7 days)
- Jason: Runbook + alerting automation (due 14 days)
- Kevin: customer scheduling + escalation owner (due 3 days)
- Olivia: customer sync + confirm change window (due 2 days)
- Sarah: owner for postmortem followups + final sign-off (due 5 days)
sarah: OK. I'll be PM on the followups and will do a weekly check-in until recurrence rate < 1/week. Marking Kevin as escalation owner.
kevin: noted. also adding dependency: on-prem firewall firmware rumored to have a bug. I've opened a vendor ticket — VID-9933.
ben: quick monitoring query I'll add to dashboard:
```
sum(rate(peering_flap_events[1h])) by (tenant)
```
will alert on >3/hr per-tenant.
olivia: once NimbusCo confirms window I'll post the customer contact and we can coordinate the change. also can offer a pre-prod config verification call.
jason: putting the runbook PR draft at https://git.redwood/runbooks/peering-isolation-draft
maria: I've created entries in the postmortem tracker and tagged with priority: P1 for strict-tenant-check, P2 for runbook automation.
sarah: thanks all — let's treat this as a recurring-pattern remediation. weekly sync Fridays until resolved. :thumbsup:
